name: Trigger 1
description: When Annual passenger congestion delay exceeds 1.86284e+06 person-hours/year for 2 consecutive years, decide to build; open after a 4-year lead time.

name: Trigger 2
description: When Peak-hour PT demand exceeds 5,295 trips/peak hour for 2 consecutive years, decide to build; open after a 1-year lead time.
